<think>**Designing grouped winner hierarchy**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none
module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
if (WIDTH == 64 && !LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY && LEVELS == 6 && W == 64) begin : fast64
    wire [7:0] group_valid;
    wire [7:0] group_enable;
    wire [7:0] group_winner;
    wire [7:0] low_bit0;
    wire [7:0] low_bit1;
    wire [7:0] low_bit2;
    genvar g, j;
    for (g = 0; g < 8; g = g + 1) begin : groups
        wire [7:0] x;
        wire [7:0] local_winner;
        assign x = input_unencoded[g*8 +: 8];
        assign group_valid[g] = |x;
        if (g == 7) begin : top_group
            assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
        end else begin : other_group
            assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[7:g+1]);
        end
        assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];
        for (j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin : bits_in_group
            if (j == 7) begin : top_bit
                assign local_winner[j] = x[j];
            end else begin : other_bit
                assign local_winner[j] = x[j] & ~(|x[7:j+1]);
            end
            if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : zero_default
                // The reference emits bit zero even when the input is zero.
                assign output_unencoded[g*8+j] = group_enable[g] & ~(|x[7:1]);
            end else begin : ordinary_output
                assign output_unencoded[g*8+j] = group_enable[g] & local_winner[j];
            end
        end
        assign low_bit0[g] = group_enable[g] & (local_winner[7] | local_winner[5] | local_winner[3] | local_winner[1]);
        assign low_bit1[g] = group_enable[g] & (local_winner[7] | local_winner[6] | local_winner[3] | local_winner[2]);
        assign low_bit2[g] = group_enable[g] & (|x[7:4]);
    end
    assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    assign output_encoded[0] = |low_bit0;
    assign output_encoded[1] = |low_bit1;
    assign output_encoded[2] = |low_bit2;
    assign output_encoded[3] = group_winner[7] | group_winner[5] | group_winner[3] | group_winner[1];
    assign output_encoded[4] = group_winner[7] | group_winner[6] | group_winner[3] | group_winner[2];
    assign output_encoded[5] = |group_valid[7:4];
end else begin : generic_encoder
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid[LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc[LEVELS-1:0];
    genvar l, n;
    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin : msb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end
    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ? {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} : {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ? {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} : {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
            end
        end
    end
    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
end
endgenerate
endmodule
`default_nettype wire
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical path reaches output_unencoded through priority selection followed by encoded-index decoding, including a heavily loaded intermediate node. Generating the one-hot result through the encoded bus creates unnecessary serial dependence.",
  "rewrite": "For the fixed 64-bit MSB-priority configuration, partition inputs into eight 8-bit groups. Compute group suppression and local winners in parallel, and drive one-hot outputs directly from those terms. Compute the encoded outputs with parallel masked reductions rather than a cascaded mux tree. Retain the original implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival by removing the encode-then-decode path to the one-hot outputs. The remaining critical path may move to the low encoded bits. No mapped timing run is available, so improvement over the 1.73 ns baseline is an estimate rather than a verified measurement.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses shared group-valid reductions, local winner terms, and group-enable masks instead of the final binary decoder. Expected to fit the 1713.518400 um2 cap, but mapped area, timing, equivalence, slew, and capacitance require evaluation with the specified flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Pure combinational logic with unchanged ports and parameter declarations. For the optimized configuration, the highest asserted input wins; an all-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=64'b1, exactly as in the reference. Other parameter configurations retain the original padding, priority, truncation, and default behavior. No state, latency, assumptions, undefined outputs, or helper modules are introduced."
}
